title: [09JUL2025] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: Most companies hide problems. Toyota built an empire upon them. Faced with post-war scarcity, fragmented demand, and limited capital, Toyota couldn't copy Ford's mass production model to survive, but this constraint became their greatest gift.

title: [04FEB2026] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: You’re in a meeting. Someone says something that triggers you. You push back. They double down. Emotions rise. Learning stops.

title: [13FEB2026] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: You're facing challenges. Your problems seem to multiply. As they grow, so does your stress. Your progress stops. Your confidence fades. You need help.

title: [19MAR2026] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: We do not start with perfect plans. We define edge conditions. We move to map them. Then to clear them. Where they hold, we obey. Where they break, we break through.

title: [06MAY2026] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: Jedi do not obey false profits. We dismantle their structures. We liberate their customers. We finish the job the great extinction began. Barbarians distract us, deceive us, and bind us. All to extract from us. They bury us in waste.

title: [03AUG2026] The JDI Way - Issue
summary: Film gave Kodak their profit, their identity, and power. Film had been their sun. They revolved around it. Customers wanted to capture memories, to share them, and to hold them in their pocket. These converged on film. That gave film its value.
